fact: Running /taskbook-setup attaches Pi model, repository, and tool diagnostics to the current conversation.
Setup requires a scoped approval for each migration source and a separate explicit approval to delete the archived original.
Setup stages the project’s model location in .fact/taskbook.tsv. A T3 worktree gets the tracked setting from its taskbook baseline.
Setup uses the common Git info/exclude to retain the project’s local model table outside Git tracking.
